pairs.registryProposal: The subject has no technique for the common 'operator clicks Fix, an agent edits the repo' shape. There the click is the consent, but the in-run limits (no delete, scope) can only be enforced by the CLI's permission layer. It would help to state outright that a human-initiated dispatch still needs its forbidden operations enforced below the prompt.

pairs.registryProposal: Most of this context is machine-only acceptance (an oracle gate with no human in it). The subject's techniques assume a human verdict, so their gate-sees-target and oracle principles carry over only by analogy. A short note on 'automated gates under the same discipline' would make such pairs judgeable without stretching.
